E0214

`.view(a..b)` uses the retired list-window spelling.

What

`.view(a..b)` uses the retired list-window spelling.

Why

Place access follows the sigil reading rule above.

Fix

Replace `value.view(a..b)` with `value[a..b]`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0214: tests/ui/view_method_retired_e0214.stderr.

Error [E0214]: `.view(a..b)` is now a bare range place
  --> tests/ui/view_method_retired_e0214.jet:3:22
    |
  3 |     window :: values.view(0..1)
    |                      ^^^^
 Why: place access follows the sigil reading rule
 Fix: replace `value.view(a..b)` with `value[a..b]`
